instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium-full shot at eye-level. In a gym next to a large red punching bag, the woman in the light blue jacket and grey shorts (R2) stands on the right, throwing a punch at the bag with her pink boxing gloves. Behind her on the left, the man in the grey t-shirt and black shorts (R1) stands watching attentively, raising his hand to coach her form. The scene is lit by bright indoor gym lights, casting soft shadows on the dark floor mats.
